settings.voice: audio prompt dia_prompt_kokoro_am_puck.wav: "Okay, so you're not gonna believe this one, but it's totally true. I looked it up like three times, because I honestly thought it was a joke."

final_transcript: America and Britain almost went to war over a pig. In 1859, on an island both sides claimed, a British company's pig got into an American's garden. He shot it. He offered $10. The British wanted $100. Britain threatened to arrest him, so America sent soldiers. Soon, 461 American troops faced five British warships. Nobody fired a shot. The only casualty was the pig.
